callouts.label: Ask Before Getting Close
callouts.hint: Two children pause with open hands inside overlapping pink space bubbles.
callouts.description: Permission helps a person choose whether a hug, touch, or close game feels welcome.
callouts.ap_tip: Ask first and wait for a clear answer.

callouts.label: Notice a Step Back
callouts.hint: One child steps back while a friend notices the larger blue bubble.
callouts.description: Stepping back, turning away, or becoming quiet can signal a need for more space.
callouts.ap_tip: Respect the signal even before someone finds words.

callouts.label: Mutual Play Feels Different
callouts.hint: Two friends chase each other with matching smiles in one green orbit.
callouts.description: Playful interaction is shared fun when everyone is participating willingly.
callouts.ap_tip: Keep checking faces and body language as the game changes.

callouts.label: Stop When the Signal Changes
callouts.hint: A child uses a stop hand while a friend holding a ball pauses.
callouts.description: A game that began as fun should stop when someone looks uncomfortable or says stop.
callouts.ap_tip: Consent can change at any moment.

callouts.label: Space Needs Vary
callouts.hint: Two peers talk comfortably inside a large blue bubble.
callouts.description: People prefer different distances depending on the person, place, activity, and day.
callouts.ap_tip: There is no single perfect bubble size.

callouts.label: Make Room to Move
callouts.hint: Friends move planet props so a wheelchair user can turn freely.
callouts.description: Respectful space includes room for bodies, mobility devices, and safe movement.
callouts.ap_tip: Ask what adjustment would help instead of assuming.

callouts.label: Interrupt Teasing
callouts.hint: A peer calmly intervenes as another child looks hurt.
callouts.description: Teasing is not playful when it embarrasses, excludes, or continues after discomfort.
callouts.ap_tip: A bystander can interrupt, include, or get adult help.

callouts.label: Check In and Repair
callouts.hint: Two children sit together and check in inside a pink bubble.
callouts.description: After a boundary mistake, listening and changing the behavior are part of repair.
callouts.ap_tip: An apology matters most when the action changes.

callouts.label: Get Trusted Help
callouts.hint: A trusted adult kneels and listens to two children.
callouts.description: Adult help is appropriate when teasing continues, safety is involved, or words feel hard.
